=== 0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
# 2. Reports go out weekly

Date: 2026-08-10

## Status

Superseded by 0014

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-08-10; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Weekly is enough; the shops do not read more often.」 — Mira Example, 2026-08-10

**Options considered:**
- the report job runs once a week, on monday morning (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs once a week, on Monday morning.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
=== 0014-reports-go-out-daily.md
# 14. Reports go out daily

Date: 2026-10-08

## Status

Superseded by 0023

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-08; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Make it daily now; the stock-out cost us a week.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-08

**Options considered:**
- the report job runs every day at 06:00 shop time (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs every day at 06:00 shop time. This replaces the weekly cadence of ADR 0002.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
=== 0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
# 23. Reports go out daily at 07:00

Date: 2026-10-14

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-14; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Seven suits the shops better than six.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-14

**Options considered:**
- the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time. This replaces the 06:00 time of ADR 0014; the daily cadence stays.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
=== 0022-decisions-are-reviewed-every-quarter.md
# 22. Decisions are reviewed every quarter

Date: 2026-10-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-12; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「A decision nobody reviews goes stale.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-12

**Options considered:**
- mira reviews the decision log every quarter and marks stale records (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** review-cadence

Mira reviews the decision log every quarter and marks stale records.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
